## Summary

Describe the user-visible or engineering change.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Behavior changes have regression coverage.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are current.
- [ ] Fixtures and screenshots use synthetic content only.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, local paths, release evidence, or generated output are included.

## Manual checks

List any macOS, Screen Recording, shortcut, multi-display, VoiceOver, packaged-app, or Gatekeeper checks that still require a person.
